patch.summary:
Thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — LearnWorlds documents a broader use-case set; Livestorm is narrower/specialist.

Comparison thesis: General-purpose vs specialist. Choose LearnWorlds only if your buying job matches “AI-powered LMS for creating, selling, and delivering online courses and academies.” rather than Livestorm's shape. Choose Livestorm only if your buying job matches “Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.” rather than LearnWorlds's shape. Workflow advantage: LearnWorlds leans funnel-building, employee-training; Livestorm leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: General-purpose vs specialist — LearnWorlds documents a broader use-case set; Livestorm is narrower/specialist.
- Positioning: LearnWorlds is AI-powered LMS for creating, selling, and delivering online courses and academies.; Livestorm is Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams..
- Company-size focus: LearnWorlds (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Livestorm (small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: LearnWorlds-leaning funnel-building, employee-training, sop-documentation vs Livestorm-leaning —.
- Researched limits: LearnWorlds — Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment; Livestorm — Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder.

Limitations — LearnWorlds: Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment; Active learner and admin caps by plan; Livestorm: Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder; Pro caps session length at 4 hours (12 on Enterprise).

Poor-fit cases: LearnWorlds is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Starter charges $5 per paid enrollment · Livestorm is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Pricing is attendee-credit based (EUR), not a simple flat SaaS ladder · Avoid LearnWorlds if you actually need Livestorm's motion (Browser-based webinar and virtual events platform for marketing teams.)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
